text: Mobile app development involves creating software for smartphones and tablets. One crucial aspect is responsive design, which ensures the app looks and works well on different screen sizes and orientations. Developers must also choose between building a native app, made specifically for one platform like iOS or Android, and a cross-platform app, which uses a single codebase that runs on multiple systems. The former offers better performance, while the latter saves time and money. After development, apps are distributed through app stores, such as the Apple App Store or Google Play, where they must meet strict guidelines. Finally, good performance is vital, as users quickly abandon apps that are slow, laggy, or drain their battery.
